messages:
alex (SRE): seeing a burst of pages from notify-bridge but some escalations never showed up in the incident queue. :warning:
incident-bot: automated alert: notify-bridge error rate > 5% (5m)
jordan (oncall): confirming — I got 3 SMS pages and a Slack ping, but they didn't create an escalation ticket.
alex (SRE): paging logs show outbound success, but escalation IDs are missing in the store. seems like notify-bridge accepted the request, sent to SMS gateway, but the post-back to our router failed.
maya (eng): digging into notify-bridge logs now, tailing prod: `kubectl logs -f deploy/notify-bridge -n prod | grep -i escalate`
alex (SRE): paste any error snippets here. also check the DB write path (escalations table).
maya (eng): found repeated stacktraces around 16:22 UTC: ```
ERROR notify.bridge.handler: failed to index escalation: json.UnmarshalTypeError: expected string but got number at key 'provider_status'
(…stack…)
```
jordan (oncall): that explains missing escalation IDs — index failed so it never recorded the mapping. customers might have been paged but incident system didn't link. potential customer impact: incidents not tracked, alerts not automatically routed.
alex (SRE): rolling a quick mitigation: patch notify-bridge to coerce provider_status to string and restart. prepping helm patch.
tim (pager): FYI our SMS partner (new-gw) had a spike in response payloads; some enums came back numeric instead of strings — compatibility regression.
maya (eng): patch ready, testing locally. helm upgrade --reuse-values --set image.tag=canary-notifyfix prod/notify-bridge
jordan (oncall): I can hold paging manual fallback — if escalation writes fail, please send manual pages to oncall list and DM.
incident-bot: deployment started: notify-bridge -> canary-notifyfix (triggered by maya)
alex (SRE): after restart I'm seeing successful writes to escalations table again. running a small synthetic to verify end-to-end: `curl -XPOST https://notify.prod/escalate -d '{"service":"api","severity":"P2"}'`
maya (eng): synthetic returned 200 and escalation id logged: id=escal_2024_174999; router accepted and created incident link.
jordan (oncall): I saw the synthetic page come through — now linking and routing worked. :thumbsup:
alex (SRE): mitigating steps summary for now: 1) patch to coerce provider_status -> string (deployed canary). 2) verify DB index and backfill for failed requests. 3) enable temporary fail-open: if indexing fails, create a fallback ticket in incident-service.
maya (eng): starting backfill job to reprocess 16:10-16:30 window; dry-run first. ETA ~12m.
tim (pager): coordinating with new-gw to confirm payload schema change; asked them to freeze changes and provide a signed fix.
jordan (oncall): customer impact assessment: a small subset of pages (approx 7) were delivered but not tracked; no known missed SLAs yet, ops contacted impacted teams. will loop in support for outreach if backfill shows any missed notifications.
alex (SRE): follow-ups: postmortem runbook entry, add stricter schema validation on inbound provider responses, add metric for indexing failures (alerts at >1/min).
maya (eng): opened GH issue: redwood/notify-bridge#482 - provider enum typing + fail-open fallback.
jordan (oncall): thanks — I'm going to manually escalate two open customer reports until backfill finishes. ping me when job completes.
incident-bot: backfill job started by maya (dry-run)
maya (eng): dry-run found 6 entries that failed indexing; switching to apply mode now.
alex (SRE): good. once applied, run reconciliation to ensure incident links exist for those IDs.
maya (eng): backfill applied, 6 escalations indexed and linked. confirmations in DB.
jordan (oncall): confirmed incidents now show correct links; reaching out to affected owners.
alex (SRE): closing immediate mitigation. will draft postmortem and include timeline and ops checklist. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
maya (eng): adding unit test for provider payload shapes and integration test against new-gw responses.
tim (pager): new-gw acknowledged schema regression and will revert unintentional change.
jordan (oncall): filing RCA ticket and scheduling follow-up 1:1 with product teams impacted.
incident-bot: thread marked resolved by alex (SRE)
